overallStatusReason: Production and staging share the same Azure resource group and container app environment. This is a P1 blast-radius risk. No data-residency violations detected in deployed container apps (all canadacentral). P0 org-isolation controls fixed in this sprint.

health.summary: May 2026 monthly: 1 deploy, 0 rollbacks, 0 hotfixes, 100% CI success rate.

deployment.summary: All 14 container apps deployed to canadacentral (correct). Production and staging share resource group 'nzila-canada-staging-rg' and environment 'nzila-canada-staging-env'. Shared blast radius is a P1 risk requiring separation before sensitive multi-org production.

dataResidency.summary: All 14 deployed container app FQDNs resolve to canadacentral.azurecontainerapps.io. No eastus/eastus2 violations detected in container app endpoints. Note: underlying Azure subscription may contain non-data-bearing operational resources in other regions — these require a signed exception ledger entry if present.

orgIsolation.summary: P0 trust-hardening sprint applied. withRLSContext now throws on missing orgId (fail-closed). withSystemRLSContext and withPlatformAdminRLSContext added as explicit audited bypass paths. Intake idempotency hash now includes organizationId. assignClaim in workflow-engine.ts wrapped in withRLSContext with org-scoped WHERE clause. Cross-org denial regression tests added.
fixes: apps/union-eyes/app/api/cases/intake/route.ts — org-scoped idempotency hash and duplicate check
apps/union-eyes/db/queries/claims-queries.ts — organizationId required in getClaimsByMember, updateClaimStatus, assignClaim
apps/union-eyes/lib/workflow-engine.ts — assignClaim wrapped in withRLSContext, org-scoped WHERE
orgIsolation.remainingDebt: 13 other Union Eyes API/query files still use raw db client (documented in scripts/check-ue-db-import-guard.ts allowlist as P1 migration backlog)
